lessons: In implement_stage, call implement_inputs with the Implement worktree as the root, so Context files are read from the worktree as before. Only requisition's base_render_chars passes repo. This keeps Implement renders byte-identical.
Render the requisition_review prompt inside the guarded path. If render() raises RenderOverBound, return a mechanical snag with no model call. Never let it propagate out of review_ticket.

Don't duplicate plan_contract and context in the requisition prompt. Since the embedded base render already contains them, pass them once, so the review prompt fits whenever the base render fits the headroom.
Add tests: implement_stage reads Context from the worktree even when the main checkout copy differs, and a review prompt over its bound returns snag with mechanical set and zero requests.
